name: talaria
description: Read and update your Talaria tasks — the Sea of Grass task manager.
long_description: Lets Claude see your projects and tasks in Talaria, create tasks and projects, assign and reschedule them, mark them done, comment, and attach files. The first time it's used, your browser opens to sign in with Google; Claude then acts as you and only sees the spaces you belong to. Nothing can be deleted through this extension.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Your Talaria name, email and spaces.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Projects with their sections and open-task counts.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Find tasks by project, space, section, assignee or due date.

tools.name: my_tasks
tools.description: Your open tasks, grouped by when they're due.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: One task with its description, subtasks, files and comments.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Rename, reassign, reschedule, complete or move a task.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Comment on a task as you.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Start a project with To do / Doing / Done.

tools.name: attach_file
tools.description: Attach a file from this computer to a task.

tools.name: sign_out
tools.description: Forget this computer's Talaria sign-in for Claude.
